info.name: AIESEC in Rwanda — Backend API
info.description:
Full API for the AIESEC in Rwanda website backend (Node.js + Express + TypeScript + Neon Postgres via Drizzle ORM).

## Getting started
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (collection Variables tab, or use the provided environment) to your local server (`http://localhost:5000/api`) or your deployed Vercel URL (`https://your-project.vercel.app/api`).
2. Run **Auth > Login** with the seeded admin account (`admin@aiesec.rw` / whatever you set during seeding). Its test script automatically saves the returned JWT into the `token` variable — every admin-only request in this collection already references `{{token}}`, so nothing else to configure.
3. Public GET endpoints (page aggregators, content lists) work with no auth at all.

Endpoints are grouped by the page they power on the actual site, matching the backend README.
